figs.name: industrial-automation-sensors-control-system-block-diagram
figs.alt: block diagram of industrial sensors sending signals to PLC, DCS and SCADA control
figs.caption: Diagram by Instrumentation Blog showing how a sensor turns a physical change into an electrical signal for a PLC, DCS or SCADA system that drives the output.
figs.svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 800 500" width="100%" font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif">
<title>Block diagram of industrial automation sensors sending signals to PLC DCS and SCADA</title>
<rect width="800" height="500" fill="#ffffff"/>
<defs><marker id="ah" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto-start-reverse"><path d="M0 0L10 5L0 10z" fill="#1a2b4a"/></marker></defs>
<text x="400.0" y="34" font-size="24" fill="#115e59" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Where Sensors Sit in an Automation System</text>
<rect x="25" y="90" width="170" height="300" rx="10" fill="#f0fdfa" stroke="#0d9488" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="110.0" y="150.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Process</text>
<text x="110.0" y="174.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">or machine</text>
<text x="110.0" y="198.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle"></text>
<text x="110.0" y="222.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">position</text>
<text x="110.0" y="246.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">presence</text>
<text x="110.0" y="270.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">pressure</text>
<text x="110.0" y="294.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">temperature</text>
<text x="110.0" y="318.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">level, flow</text>
<text x="110.0" y="342.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">speed</text>
<line x1="197" y1="240" x2="245" y2="240" stroke="#0d9488" stroke-width="3" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<text x="221" y="225" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle"></text>
<rect x="250" y="160" width="160" height="160" rx="10" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#0d9488" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="330.0" y="210.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Sensor</text>
<text x="330.0" y="234.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">detects the</text>
<text x="330.0" y="258.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">physical</text>
<text x="330.0" y="282.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">change</text>
<line x1="412" y1="240" x2="462" y2="240" stroke="#0d9488" stroke-width="3" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<text x="437" y="210" font-size="17" fill="#115e59" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">signal</text>
<rect x="465" y="150" width="150" height="180" rx="10" fill="#0d9488" stroke="#115e59" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="540.0" y="209.15" font-size="19" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Controller</text>
<text x="540.0" y="234.15" font-size="19" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">PLC</text>
<text x="540.0" y="259.15" font-size="19" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">DCS</text>
<text x="540.0" y="284.15" font-size="19" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">SCADA</text>
<line x1="617" y1="240" x2="650" y2="240" stroke="#0d9488" stroke-width="3" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<rect x="652" y="160" width="125" height="160" rx="10" fill="#f0fdfa" stroke="#0d9488" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="714.5" y="210.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Output</text>
<text x="714.5" y="234.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">motor,</text>
<text x="714.5" y="258.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">valve,</text>
<text x="714.5" y="282.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">alarm</text>
<polyline points="714,322 714,430 110,430 110,394" fill="none" stroke="#115e59" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)" stroke-dasharray="7 5"/>
<text x="412" y="460" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">The output acts on the process and the sensor sees the change</text>
<text x="412" y="76" font-size="18" fill="#4b5563" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">Sensors are the eyes and ears of automation</text>
</svg>

figs.name: industrial-automation-sensors-selection-flowchart
figs.alt: flowchart to choose proximity, photoelectric, encoder, pressure, temperature, level or flow sensor
figs.caption: Diagram by Instrumentation Blog showing how to pick an industrial sensor by what must be sensed: object presence, shaft rotation or a process variable.
figs.after_h2: Why Are Sensors Important in Industrial Automation?
figs.svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 800 600" width="100%" font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif">
<title>Flowchart to choose an industrial automation sensor by what you need to measure</title>
<rect width="800" height="600" fill="#ffffff"/>
<defs><marker id="ah" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto-start-reverse"><path d="M0 0L10 5L0 10z" fill="#1a2b4a"/></marker></defs>
<text x="400.0" y="34" font-size="24" fill="#115e59" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Which Sensor Do You Need?</text>
<rect x="270" y="56" width="260" height="46" rx="10" fill="#f0fdfa" stroke="#0d9488" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="400.0" y="85.65" font-size="19" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">What must be sensed?</text>
<line x1="400" y1="102" x2="400" y2="118" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<polygon points="400,118.0 545.0,160 400,202.0 255.0,160" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#0d9488" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="400" y="155.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Is an object</text>
<text x="400" y="177.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">present?</text>

<text x="232" y="148" font-size="17" fill="#115e59" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Yes</text>

<text x="120" y="155.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Short</text>
<text x="120" y="177.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">range?</text>
<polyline points="35,160 14,160 14,372 28,372" fill="none" stroke="#115e59" stroke-width="2" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<text x="22" y="150" font-size="17" fill="#115e59" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="start">No</text>
<rect x="30" y="330" width="180" height="84" rx="10" fill="#115e59" stroke="#115e59" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="120.0" y="354.95" font-size="17" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Photoelectric</text>
<text x="120.0" y="377.95" font-size="17" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">longer range,</text>
<text x="120.0" y="400.95" font-size="17" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">metal or not</text>
<line x1="120" y1="202" x2="120" y2="236" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<text x="140" y="224" font-size="17" fill="#115e59" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="start">Yes</text>
<rect x="30" y="236" width="180" height="84" rx="10" fill="#0d9488" stroke="#115e59" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="120.0" y="260.95" font-size="17" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Proximity</text>
<text x="120.0" y="283.95" font-size="17" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">inductive or</text>
<text x="120.0" y="306.95" font-size="17" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">capacitive</text>
<line x1="400" y1="202" x2="400" y2="236" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<text x="420" y="224" font-size="17" fill="#115e59" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="start">No</text>
<polygon points="400,238.0 545.0,290 400,342.0 255.0,290" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#0d9488" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="400" y="285.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Is a shaft</text>
<text x="400" y="307.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">rotating?</text>
<line x1="545" y1="290" x2="590" y2="290" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<text x="567" y="278" font-size="17" fill="#115e59" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Yes</text>
<rect x="592" y="255" width="185" height="70" rx="10" fill="#0d9488" stroke="#115e59" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="684.5" y="284.3" font-size="18" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Encoder</text>
<text x="684.5" y="308.3" font-size="18" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">position, speed</text>
<line x1="400" y1="342" x2="400" y2="372" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<text x="420" y="362" font-size="17" fill="#115e59" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="start">No</text>
<rect x="250" y="372" width="300" height="46" rx="10" fill="#f0fdfa" stroke="#0d9488" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="400.0" y="401.65" font-size="19" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Process variable</text>
<line x1="400" y1="418" x2="110" y2="470" stroke="#115e59" stroke-width="2" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<rect x="20" y="470" width="180" height="70" rx="10" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#0d9488" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="110.0" y="499.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Pressure</text>
<text x="110.0" y="522.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">gauge or DP</text>
<line x1="400" y1="418" x2="302" y2="470" stroke="#115e59" stroke-width="2" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<rect x="212" y="470" width="180" height="70" rx="10" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#0d9488" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="302.0" y="499.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Temperature</text>
<text x="302.0" y="522.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">RTD, thermocouple</text>
<line x1="400" y1="418" x2="494" y2="470" stroke="#115e59" stroke-width="2" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<rect x="404" y="470" width="180" height="70" rx="10" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#0d9488" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="494.0" y="499.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Level</text>
<text x="494.0" y="522.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">float, ultrasonic</text>
<line x1="400" y1="418" x2="686" y2="470" stroke="#115e59" stroke-width="2" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<rect x="596" y="470" width="180" height="70" rx="10" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#0d9488" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="686.0" y="499.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Flow</text>
<text x="686.0" y="522.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">magnetic, turbine</text>
<text x="400" y="575" font-size="17" fill="#4b5563" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">Every sensor converts the change into an electrical signal for the controller</text>
</svg>
